cu.use: Nhà phàm trần — vùng Phàm Cư (dân ở)
cu.subject: Mortal village houses at the foot of an immortal sect mountain, 1×1 tile each. Simple Song-dynasty rural architecture: rammed-earth or whitewashed walls, wooden posts, small courtyards.
rows: Row 1 — level 1 THATCHED COTTAGES (thảo xá), small and humble, about 40% of the dashed box height: (1) thatched hut with a woven fence, (2) thatched cottage with a drying rack of herbs, (3) tiny hut with a water jar and a hoe by the door.

Row 2 — level 2 TILED HOUSES (trạch viện), about 65% of the box height: (4) tiled-roof house with a small walled courtyard, (5) L-shaped tiled house with a well, (6) tiled house with a bamboo grove behind a low wall.

Row 3 — level 3 TWO-STOREY RESIDENCES (lâu các), filling most of the box: (7) two-storey house with a balcony and hanging lanterns, (8) courtyard mansion with an upturned-eave gate, (9) two-storey house with a small tower room on top.

thi.use: Cửa hàng — vùng Phường Thị (buôn bán)
thi.subject: Market buildings of a small xianxia town, 1×1 tile each. Song-dynasty shops with shop flags, cloth awnings and goods on display.
rows: Row 1 — level 1 STALLS, small, about 40% of the dashed box height: (1) noodle stall with a cloth awning and benches, (2) herb stall with baskets, (3) street stall with pottery and a red shop flag.

Row 2 — level 2 SHOPS, about 65% of the box height: (4) tea house with an open front and a hanging sign board, (5) cloth shop with bolts of silk at the door, (6) talisman and paper shop with yellow paper hanging.

Row 3 — level 3 TWO-STOREY TRADING HOUSES, filling most of the box: (7) two-storey restaurant with red lanterns and a tall shop flag, (8) spirit-stone exchange with a stone lion at the door, (9) two-storey inn with a balcony.

dien.use: Ruộng nương — vùng Linh Điền (việc làm ruộng)
dien.subject: Spirit-farm plots of a xianxia village, 1×1 tile each, seen as small isometric dioramas: neat raised field beds of glowing-green spirit rice and herbs, irrigation channels, farm structures.
rows: Row 1 — level 1 SMALL PLOTS, low, about 25% of the dashed box height: (1) three rows of young spirit rice in wet soil, (2) small vegetable and herb beds with a bamboo fence, (3) plot with a scarecrow.
Row 2 — level 2 FIELDS WITH A HUT, about 45% of the box height: (4) rice field with a small thatched field hut, (5) herb field with a water wheel on a channel, (6) field with stacked harvest sheaves.

Row 3 — level 3 TERRACED FARMS, about 65% of the box height: (7) terraced spirit-rice paddies with a granary, (8) herb garden with a drying pavilion, (9) field with a round granary and a small shrine.
